channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
item.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight, promptable model transcribing 40 languages, translating 31 to and from English, labeling speakers in 13 languages, handling hour-long recordings with up to eight speakers, and cutting medical word error rate 45.8% after fine-tuning. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: Our next frontier model
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon is described as the strongest model yet, with state-of-the-art cybersecurity capabilities and long-horizon task performance as its core positioning. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion
item.description: GitHub Copilot Fusion is now generally available, routing and orchestrating models per task instead of requiring manual selection, with its Max variant scoring 60 while cutting API cost roughly in half and time by about 40%. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership across enterprise workflows
item.description: OpenAI and ServiceNow expanded their partnership to bring OpenAI models and agents into ServiceNow development, IT and security workflows, and ServiceNow workflows into ChatGPT and Codex, with a ServiceNow MCP plugin already on OpenAI’s marketplace. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Google's AI search problem finally shows up in the earnings report, some investors believe
item.description: Google’s search revenue grew about 12%, missing the 15% analysts expected, while its market value briefly fell as much as 10%; Philipp Schindler linked strong AI Mode query growth to lower monetization, and Google planned international chatbot ads.

item.title: GitHub Copilot app, Universe releases
item.description: GitHub Copilot app's Projects, now in public preview, gathers work spanning multiple repositories or no repository at all, pulls in Slack and Figma context, and has Copilot coordinate multiple agents that return pull requests for review. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: AI can finally delete files without asking! Claude Code rolls out a new environment variable that gives developers blanket permission.
item.description: Claude Code now supports a new environment variable that lets developers skip the confirmation prompt for file deletions, granting the AI blanket permission to remove files without repeated approval requests. (AIbase)

item.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing shows $131.7B in cash and short-term investments, a bigger pile than Amazon’s or Microsoft’s.
item.description: Anthropic’s IPO filing shows $131.7B in cash and short-term investments, more than Amazon and Microsoft, above Nvidia and Apple combined, and second among U.S. non-bank companies only to Berkshire Hathaway and Alphabet.

item.title: Anthropic report: Claude research model finds vulnerabilities in Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows, and Linux, stringing together 5 attack chains
item.description: Anthropic reported on 27 October that an undisclosed internal Claude research model found vulnerabilities across Chrome, Safari, Android, Windows and Linux and chained five working attack paths, including 62 high-severity Chrome CVEs and a Linux flaw yielding zero-click root in about 53 minutes.

item.title: You're probably overprompting Claude
item.description: Stripping over 80% of the Claude Code system prompt from Claude Opus 5 and Claude Fable 5 caused no measurable coding regression, so Addy Osmani advises giving Opus 5.5 one goal with verification and starting at /effort medium.

item.title: How to Extract Tables from a PDF with an LLM
item.description: Python sends a PDF plus strict JSON schema to a file-reading LLM, returning typed table rows; OpenRouter's tutorial reports 644 cells all correct across five test PDFs, two scanned, but two silent failures from PDF input paths.

item.title: Exit Liquidity
item.description: Ed Zitron argues Anthropic’s S-1 discloses only Q2 profit while omitting Q3 cash and payment details, and, citing Torsten Slok, notes S&P 500 margins have worsened since ChatGPT’s November 2022 launch without AI lifting ROIC.

item.title: Q3 is in the books! We’re now on a half-trillion annual revenue run rate, with Alphabet revenues growing at 25%.
item.description: Alphabet’s Q3 revenue grew 25% to a half-trillion-dollar annual run rate, with Google Cloud up 103% and first-party model APIs handling nearly 32B tokens per minute, as Search query growth hit a five-year high.

item.title: GitHub Enterprise now includes access to GitHub Copilot
item.description: GitHub Enterprise now bundles Copilot for every licensed user, replacing separate seat and AI-usage management with usage metered against the enterprise budget from the first request, while non-licensed users can get Copilot Standalone at $10 per user monthly, excluding monthly AI credits. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents
item.description: GitHub's 2026 Octoverse reports 17.9 billion code pushes in the past 12 months, more than 2024 and 2025 combined, plus 1.3 billion merged PRs and new repos with agent config files averaging 8x the commits of those without. (GitHub Blog)

item.title: Anthropic hands enterprises a supervisor's key: Claude can now see every employee's AI spend
item.description: Anthropic is handing enterprises a supervision key that lets Claude see each employee's AI spending, with the article explaining how this enterprise-side control puts staff Claude costs in front of managers. (AIbase)

item.title: Utah gave Claude Code to 34 developers across 10 state agencies. 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes, 71% reported saving 20+...
item.description: Utah’s four-week Claude Code pilot with 34 developers across 10 state agencies found 80% had a working environment within 30 minutes and 71% reported saving more than 20 hours.

item.title: OpenMOSS releases MOSS-Image, an open-source image generation model focused on long-text rendering and editable layouts
item.description: OpenMOSS's open-weight MOSS-Image is a 5B-parameter single-stream DiT pretrained from scratch that renders long Chinese and English text from prompts up to 4K tokens, offers an editable JSON Layout, and scores 96.3 Mean-6 on LongLongTextBench, the top open-weight result.

item.title: Security extension for the GitHub Copilot app
item.description: Security extension for the GitHub Copilot app (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: GitHub launches Copilot Fusion, using multi-model auto-orchestration to boost coding efficiency and cost-effectiveness
item.description: GitHub launches Copilot Fusion, using multi-model auto-orchestration to boost coding efficiency and cost-effectiveness (AIbase)
